name: Agency AI
description:
Agency AI connects your Shopify store's Meta and Google ad accounts to Claude, so you can ask what's happening in your campaigns instead of opening a dashboard.

Ask things like:

Where should I move budget before month end?
Why did ROAS drop last week?
Which campaigns can I add to horizontally scale on Meta?
Which creative should I iterate on?

Claude reads your live account: campaign performance (spend, revenue, ROAS, impressions, clicks, conversions), daily trends, month-to-date budget pacing, statistically detected spend and ROAS anomalies, and your store's brand and margin profile. Recommendations are grounded in your actual economics, not generic best practice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agency AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agency AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://s.agencyai.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agency AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agency AI provides these MCP tools: get_anomalies, get_brand_info, get_campaigns, get_pacing, get_performance_timeseries, and get_recommendations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agency AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agency AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Agency AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agency AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agency AI is developed by Agency AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
